full_page.content:
1937, September
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 209 Sept. 1 Martha Nogoshi - T.B. - 19 years - getting worse.
Mrs. Deuk - losing home ....
Edna Corbeile - 16 - has good work now - becoming quite authorative - refuses to listen to widowd mother.
Mrs. Gelhaus - intestinal and nervous
Salesbury - Family trouble -
Mrs. Hazel Daure - 43 - raised Baptist - Paralized - raising her children Catholic.
Borland Family .. Fond du Lac Casey Leo McNulty wants Sweapstakes ticket
Page 210 Sep. 2nd Joseph V. Krimmel - 41 - fractured skull - wife lutheran - asks prayers - she enrolls Poor Souls ... 3rd improving
E'd Stairs - 34 - presbiterian - drinks for quite some yrs. Now becoming dope fiend - gives family much trouble - otherwise.
Eliz. Mohan - 40 - of Cleveland. . . Work
Patrick McGowan - 19 - of Chicago - spinal maningitis - 22 years ago - has completely lost hearing - gets discouraged ...
Mrs. Rose Hartwell - 62 - invalid blind in Kiefer's Hosp. Husband not very well either - Hopes to find someone to pay for operation. Joseph Seguin - 22 - lame side ten yr's- now for 2 yrs much worse - right arm totaly helpless. Advised reading of B. Mariae V. - Life
Dr. Pillow - about 50 - complication - thought to be dead two weeks ago .... charitable ....
Page 211 Sep. 15 Wm. Whalen - 16 - disintery 3 month - now down to 93 1bs.
Marguerite Rivers - 31 - baptist - worries about deceased son - left die without baptism. Boy ten yrs. of age and only child. Mother realizes now to her sorrow the mistake not to have baptized him .... lost ten pounds since boy died a month ago.
